text: Repaired all verified post-P7.4 escapes. CanonicalJson recursively strips decimal trailing zeros so 1, 1.0, 1e0 and nested equivalents hash identically; numeric and negative-zero laws pass. ScriptSource remains an enum with the same three cases, ordinals, pattern shape and wire shape, but every generated JVM constructor/apply/copy/fromProduct path now passes a Boolean invariant into the enum base constructor; reflection tests prove apply/copy reject limit+1 and javap confirms the public constructor invokes the check. The local release gate now requires explicit JAVA_HOME and specification version 17 before sbt, with deterministic rejection tests for missing and JDK-25 homes. The evidence document now records the earlier 516/lane JDK-25 run as implementation—not release—evidence. Also repaired two resolvable internal Scaladoc links; cats-effect ExitCode remains an upstream external-link warning. Verification: scalafmt/workflow checks clean; 519 tests pass on each Scala 3.3.8 and 3.8.4; +doc, +publishLocal and worker/packageBin complete under the available JDK 25. A conforming JDK-17 local gate remains unavailable on this machine and is explicitly not claimed.
